summary: Village Super Market, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per Class A share and $0.1625 per Class B share, payable July 23, 2026 to holders of record July 2, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return (beyond a routine declared dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change occurred. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
